summary: The app is thoroughly conservative: vanilla JS on long-stable web platform APIs (fetch, history, URL, replaceAll at ES2021 being the newest) with a Node-core-only static server. Experimental-API count is effectively zero, which for this dimension is the low-risk end of the spectrum.
